hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *skills/*|*agents/*) jq -n --arg f "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("A skill or subagent definition changed: " + $f + ". Review docs/guide/ and docs/harness/ in this repo and update whichever page describes it - docs/guide/README.md indexes the guide pages; docs/harness/claude-code.md and docs/harness/cursor.md cover platform-specific subagent/tool mapping.")}}' ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
